_comment: All margins are Democratic minus Republican, two-party, in percentage points. Defaults are conservative starting values; `python -m electable calibrate` re-estimates the *_sd values from MEDSL historical results and writes config/calibrated.json, which overrides these.

national._doc: National environment = precision-weighted blend of the generic-ballot average and a fundamentals prior.

prior._doc: Race prior = state/district lean + national environment + incumbency + fundraising.
